turns.input: $improve $yaml Improve our SOP-writing prompt for Claude: "Turn this into a how-to for the team." We paste a transcript of a senior clerk narrating a screen recording, and Claude writes a step-by-step procedure for new accounts-payable clerks on booking a supplier credit note against an open invoice. Each step needs one action, the screen or field it happens in and what the clerk should see afterwards. Steps that need a second approver, for credit notes above EUR 5,000, must be marked. Keep the clerk's field names exactly as spoken and leave out the chit-chat. The result goes into Confluence. Use CIDI. No questions, just use your judgment.
